title: Donegal® Named to RISE’s Elite 50 Internships List for Second Consecutive Year
summary: Donegal Insurance Group® has been named to RISE's recently released ranking of 50 Elite Internships for the second consecutive year.
body_markdown:
**MARIETTA, Pa. (October 5, 2026)** – Donegal Insurance Group® has earned industry-wide recognition for the second year in a row for its commitment to developing the next generation of insurance industry talent. Rising Insurance Star Executives’ recently released ranking of top insurance internships named Donegal to its list of the RISE Elite 50 Internships for 2026.


Published annually, the RISE Elite 50 Internships list recognizes internship programs in the insurance industry that go above and beyond to develop talent, provide real-world experiences, and inspire the next generation of leaders.


> “Donegal’s strong history is reflected in our culture – a culture that is not simply talked about, but lived out every day,” said Lauren Gerhart, HR Business Partner. “Our internship program is one of the many ways we bring our culture to life. This honor from RISE reflects Donegal’s continued commitment to developing young professionals by cultivating an experience with influential opportunities that enhances interns’ ability to grow and thrive – now and in the future – as they begin their careers in the insurance industry.”


RISE’s 2026 Elite 50 Internships were selected based on key criteria that include mentorship opportunities, leadership development, diversity and inclusion efforts, unique approaches to experiential learning, and more. Amongst its peers, Donegal was specifically recognized for giving interns the “best sense of belonging.”


> “Here at Donegal, we aim to create a true sense of belonging by intentionally making time for interns to build relationships with team members at all levels, contribute to meaningful work, and implement what they’ve learned in the classroom to the workplace,” Gerhart added. “Our goal is for every intern to leave knowing that they were more than a participant in our internship program; they were a valued member of our team who made a meaningful impact and had a place at Donegal from day one.”


**ABOUT Donegal®**


*Donegal Insurance Group provides commercial and personal insurance products through a network of independent agents in 21 states and across several regions of the U.S. In Texas, Colorado, Utah, New Mexico and Arizona, business is conducted under the Mountain States Insurance Group name; and in Michigan, business is conducted under the Michigan Insurance name. Headquartered in Marietta, Pa., the Company has been in the insurance business for more than 130 years.*
